content.text: Navy blue works with yellow-gold, white or silver-coloured, and rose-coloured jewellery. Yellow-gold adds warmth, white finishes create a crisp contrast, and rose-coloured finishes give a softer accent. For daytime, keep the pieces simple; for a wedding guest look, choose earrings that suit the neckline; for evening, make one piece the focal point. Navy is deep and understated, so you can choose the finish based on your outfit and personal style.

content.heading: Choose a finish for the look you want

rows: Daytime polish or a warmer evening look
A gentler contrast for a personal look

content.text: These are styling options, not rules. The dress fabric, lighting, other accessories and the jewellery you already wear can all affect the result.

Add the [Letizia Necklace](/products/iwjnk0019) if the neckline leaves space; wear the [Serafina Bracelet](/products/iwjbr0003) for a delicate wrist detail
[Orsola Drop Earrings](/products/iwjer0017) with an open or simple neckline
Keep the necklace fine or leave it off; add Serafina if you want a coordinated finish
Orsola drops for movement, or studs if the dress has strong embellishment
Choose either a visible necklace or earrings as the focal point; keep the remaining pieces restrained

content.text: The linked products currently list several colour options, but check each page for the available finish and product details before ordering.
For a daytime outfit, try simple diamond studs in the finish you wear most often. Add a delicate necklace only if it sits clearly against the neckline rather than competing with a collar or scarf.

A fine bracelet can complete the look without making it feel too formal. The [Serafina Bracelet](/products/iwjbr0003) is listed as a fine chain with diamond details and has yellow, rose and white colour options.

For a wedding guest outfit, start with the neckline and the dress details. Drop earrings can add movement to a simple open neckline; studs can be a quieter choice for a dress with lace, sequins, embroidery or a high neckline.

Try the [Orsola Drop Earrings](/products/iwjer0017) with a simple navy dress. If the earrings are the main jewellery feature, skip the statement necklace or choose a fine chain. For more wedding-specific advice, see [What Earrings to Wear as a Wedding Guest](/resources/lab-grown-diamond-guides/what-earrings-to-wear-as-a-wedding-guest).
Navy can work well with a more noticeable jewellery piece, especially when the dress is simple. Choose drops, a pendant or a bracelet as the focal point, then let the other pieces support it.

For a cool, coordinated look, pair white-coloured earrings with the [Letizia Necklace](/products/iwjnk0019) in a matching finish. For a warmer effect, choose yellow-gold-coloured earrings and keep the necklace simple or leave it off.
If the dress has a high neckline or embellishment, make the earrings the focus. If it has an open neckline, a pendant may work better.

content.heading: Match jewellery to the dress fabric and neckline

items: Navy satin: Satin reflects light, so choose one focal piece and keep the rest simple.
Navy lace or embroidery: Try studs or restrained drops to avoid competing with the fabric.
Navy tailoring: Studs or hoops can create a clean daytime look; add a fine necklace if the collar allows.
Strapless or open neckline: You can choose between a necklace and visible earrings, or wear both in balanced proportions.
High neckline: Earrings may be enough; a necklace is optional.

content.text: For fabric-specific suggestions, see [What Jewellery to Wear with a Satin Dress](/resources/earring-style-guides/what-jewellery-to-wear-with-a-satin-dress).

content.heading: Navy and cobalt blue: keep the styling distinct

content.text: Navy is deeper and more subdued than bright cobalt. That gives you room to use either a restrained combination or a warmer metal-colour contrast. Cobalt is more vivid, so jewellery may need to be chosen with its stronger colour presence in mind.
For styling with brighter blue, see the separate [cobalt blue dress jewellery guide](/resources/earring-style-guides/jewellery-for-cobalt-blue-dress).

faq.question: What colour jewellery goes best with a navy blue dress?
faq.answer: Yellow-gold colour adds warmth, white or silver-coloured jewellery gives a crisp contrast, and rose-coloured jewellery creates a softer accent. Choose the effect you like and consider your other accessories.

faq.question: Can I wear gold with a navy dress?
faq.answer: Yes. Yellow-gold-coloured jewellery creates a warm contrast with navy. It can work for daytime, weddings and evening outfits.

faq.question: Is silver jewellery suitable for a navy dress?
faq.answer: Yes. White or silver-coloured jewellery gives a clean, cool contrast and can suit both formal and everyday looks.

faq.question: What earrings should I wear with a navy dress to a wedding?
faq.answer: Choose earrings based on the neckline and fabric. Drops can work with a simple open neckline, while studs can suit a high or heavily detailed dress.

faq.question: Should I wear a necklace with a navy dress?
faq.answer: It depends on the neckline. Try a pendant with an open neckline; consider skipping the necklace if the dress has a high collar or strong embellishment.

faq.question: Can I wear rose-gold-coloured jewellery with navy?
faq.answer: Yes. Rose-coloured finishes create a softer contrast with navy. You can match the earrings and necklace or use rose colour as one small accent.
